MORTGAGE CONTRACT

This Mortgage Contract (the "Agreement"), dated as of the 1st day of January, 2023, is entered into between Emily Grant-Cole, residing at 069 Lukepad, 4132 YI, Bussum (the "Borrower"), and Best Mortgage Lenders Ltd, a company incorporated under the laws of the United Kingdom, having its registered office at 55 High Street, London (the "Lender").

WHEREAS, the Borrower desires to borrow the sum of £200,000 (the "Loan Amount") from the Lender, and the Lender is willing to provide the Loan Amount to the Borrower on the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement;

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and promises contained herein and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows:

1. LOAN AND REPAYMENT

(a) Loan. The Lender agrees to provide the Loan Amount to the Borrower for the purpose of purchasing a residential property located at the local latlng of (-4.099581, 126.327729).

(b) Repayment. The Borrower agrees to repay the Loan Amount in monthly installments, according to the following schedule:

- Initial Payment: £500 per month for the first 24 months.
- Balloon Payment: The remaining balance of the Loan Amount, due on the 25th month.

(c) Late Payment. If the Borrower fails to make any payment when due, the Lender may charge a late fee of £25 per occurrence.

2. INTEREST RATE

The annual interest rate for the Loan Amount is 3.5%.

3. COLLATERAL

The Loan Amount is secured by a mortgage on the residential property located at the local latlng of (-4.099581, 126.327729).
